Also caused 8 days stoppage, loss 144,057 yuan. So crimes: assault causing light injury (故意伤害) maybe? Also obstruction of business? Possibly "非法阻碍施工" could be "破坏生产经营" or "非法拘禁"? But here they didn't destroy property, just stopped work. Could be "非法阻碍生产经营罪". In Chinese law, "非法阻碍生产经营罪" is for causing loss to business by interfering with production. So likely charges: 故意伤害;非法阻碍生产经营.

Thus answer: multiple crimes: for Li: 故意伤害; for Wang: 故意伤害; also both: 非法阻碍生产经营. But format expects list of crimes separated by semicolon. Probably combine: 故意伤害;非法阻碍生产经营.
